Implementation and verification are complete on `origin/main` revision `57f4ab26f5`. The change modifies only `scripts/check_docs_index.py`, `tests/unit/test_check_docs_index.py`, and `docs/documentation-policy.md`. Lint passed. Type checking passed across 632 source files. The focused checker and CI documentation contract set passed with 52 tests. The expanded repository checker and `git diff --check` passed.

The earlier full suite completed with 15,780 passed, 63 skipped, 297 deselected, and one failure. The failure occurred in fixture setup for `test_ineligible_completion_record_runs_fresh_verification[FAIL-True-True]`. An isolated temporary-store `git commit` exceeded the 30-second watchdog before the completion-attestation behavior ran. Both sibling parameters passed during the suite. The exact failed node then passed alone in 55.48 seconds. No F07 path participates in that commit path. A second full-suite run was not performed.

No suitable open ticket owned this recurrence. Created `expectable-slowwitted-squeaker` and linked it with `discovered_from`. The bug records the distinction from closed lock-acquisition ticket `royal-weariless-zebrafish` and the separate-tracking direction in `moldavite-evasive-elephant`.
